reference: Released Flink SQL/JSON provider profiles; Comet streaming selection and Arrow JSON writing. Wide compatible integer/boolean/null documents serialize their selected container directly from the recycled SIMD tape. Jackson edge documents validate through the exact reader and serialize the selected span with a flat indexed arena. Borrow unescaped keys and retain decoded UTF-16 identity for escaped keys. Stable member grouping preserves final duplicate values, Java UTF-16 order on 2.2 and first insertion order on 1.18.
method: Release production whole-Calc encoding, VARCHAR results and equivalent length/first/last checksums. Stock starts on prebuilt Generic/Binary RowData; native starts on prebuilt Arrow RecordBatch. Rust timing begins after setup/import and ends before export; production Calc, output consumption, allocations, intrinsic conversions and per-batch Jackson recycler metadata JNI remain timed. Actual preceding production encoder/library retain whole-Calc JVM evaluation and its intrinsic conversions inside timing. Complete jobs include planning/submission, row source/sink, JNI and both transposes.

Wide objects contain 32 reverse-inserted members with three-element arrays. Deep objects contain 24 single-member levels. Identical candidate/previous fixture bytecode and Java/Rust result checksums; no other test/build/benchmark runs concurrently with timing.

correctness.evidence: Complete 5003-row maps and schema cover Generic/Binary, nullable/NOT NULL, signed paths, all wrappers/policies, duplicate and isolated-surrogate member identity, numeric/depth/token limits, malformed/unselected values, filtered empty batches and retained generated routes. Admitted SQL paths consume NativeCalc, have no fallback and empty JVM evaluator descriptors. Direct JNI fixtures compare released-provider results under controlled recycler capacities and varying batch sizes. Large pathological documents appear once per corpus traversal to bound retained collected-result metrics.
correctness.preceding_scope: Actual preceding e533 encoder/library exposes the isolated-surrogate member collapse in a generated branching-path control. The generated SQL/JSON carrier now retains Java UTF-16 through selection. This is separate from the open general multi-reader scheduling bug #608, which this admission only guards against.
correctness.upstream_scope: Unchanged released JsonFunctionsITCase with the suite agent: 489 on 2.2.1 and 142 on 1.18.1, JDK17, no failures/skips/aborts. Broad regression evidence; not a claim that all released cases use the new kernel.
correctness.bytecode_equivalence: Final focused/related/parity and performance RexExpression javap -c -p instructions including nested classes match on both releases. Candidate/preceding benchmark fixture classes are byte-identical.
correctness.excluded_runs: Earlier failing route-assertion and result-retention/OOM harness pilots are not qualification. Initial slower performance measurements are retained separately. Sampled profiling runs are excluded from throughput statistics.

optimization.profile: Initial 1.18 wide/deep native stacks show repeated TreeParser allocations, SipHash member deduplication and recursive-tree destruction/free. Flat arena indexes remove per-container child allocations and recursive drop; borrowed ordinary keys remove UTF-16/key-output allocation; grouping replaces legacy hash tables and single-member objects bypass sorting. A second profile on the arena implementation identifies validation/reparsing, key sorting and arena growth on wide documents. The final implementation reuses the existing compatible SIMD tape and serializes its selected container directly, avoiding duplicate parsing and arena allocation. Incompatible documents keep the exact reader plus arena.
optimization.allocation_scope: One untimed release production batch per cell; counts and requested bytes cover Rust allocations and retain output-buffer sizes. JVM allocations are not counted. Requested bytes are cumulative allocations, not retained memory.

provenance.previous_runtime_source: Exact e533 preceding production tree. Only the example benchmark fixture is replaced by the identical candidate corpus; no preceding production edits. Preceding DSO is the frozen released artifact qualified with that commit.
